mentions.name: CodeMic
mentions.description: A VS Code extension to record and share coding sessions directly inside the editor, like Asciinema but for full coding sessions with audio, video, and images. Local-first and open source, it makes following tutorials and understanding real codebases more practical than watching a video.
mentions.problem: Watching videos is less practical for following tutorials and understanding real codebases than stepping through actual coding sessions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on CodeMic, a VS Code extension to record and share coding sessions directly inside your editor.

Think Asciinema, but for full coding sessions with audio, video, and images.

It makes following tutorials and understanding real codebases much more practical than watching a video.

Local first, and open source.
